entries.title: Proverbs 31:1
segments: ¶The words of King Lemuel, the utterance which his mother taught him:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:2
segments: What, my son? And what, son of my womb? And what, son of my vows?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:3
segments: Do not give your strength to women, Nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:4
segments: [It is] not for kings, O Lemuel, [It is] not for kings to drink wine, Nor for princes intoxicating drink;

entries.title: Proverbs 31:5
segments: Lest they drink and forget the law, And pervert the justice of all the afflicted.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:6
segments: Give strong drink to him who is perishing, And wine to those who are bitter of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:7
segments: Let him drink and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:8
segments: Open your mouth for the speechless, In the cause of all [who are] appointed to die.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:9
segments: Open your mouth, judge righteously, And plead the cause of the poor and needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:10
segments: ¶Who can find a virtuous wife? For her worth [is] far above rubies.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:11
segments: The heart of her husband safely trusts her; So he will have no lack of gain.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:12
segments: She does him good and not evil All the days of her life.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:13
segments: She seeks wool and flax, And willingly works with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:14
segments: She is like the merchant ships, She brings her food from afar.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:15
segments: She also rises while it is yet night, And provides food for her household, And a portion for her maidservants.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:16
segments: She considers a field and buys it; From her profits she plants a vineyard.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:17
segments: She girds herself with strength, And strengthens her arms.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:18
segments: She perceives that her merchandise [is] good, And her lamp does not go out by night.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:19
segments: She stretches out her hands to the distaff, And her hand holds the spindle.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:20
segments: She extends her hand to the poor, Yes, she reaches out her hands to the needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:21
segments: She is not afraid of snow for her household, For all her household [is] clothed with scarlet.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:22
segments: She makes tapestry for herself; Her clothing [is] fine linen and purple.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:23
segments: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sits among the elders of the land.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:24
segments: She makes linen garments and sells [them], And supplies sashes for the merchants.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:25
segments: Strength and honor [are] her clothing; She shall rejoice in time to come.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:26
segments: She opens her mouth with wisdom, And on her tongue [is] the law of kindness.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:27
segments: She watches over the ways of her household, And does not eat the bread of idleness.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:28
segments: Her children rise up and call her blessed; Her husband [also], and he praises her:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:29
segments: "Many daughters have done well, But you excel them all."

entries.title: Proverbs 31:30
segments: Charm [is] deceitful and beauty [is] passing, But a woman [who] fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:31
segments: Give her of the fruit of her hands, And let her own works praise her in the gates.
